content.short: Suku provides Web3 communities with simple yet powerful tools and incentives to grow faster.
content.description: Onboarding and the user experience for newcomers remain major hurdles in Web3 and crypto. Traditional approaches have focused on building distinct platforms and Web3 ecosystems, which can slow adoption among people who are not crypto native. Suku addresses this by onboarding social media users into the Web3 space with intuitive, user-friendly tools, effectively bridging Web2 and Web3 to enable a seamless and effortless transition for everyday users.
content.meta: Suku is a Web3 social app that helps communities grow with simple, powerful tools. Discover Suku and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
